'''Chirpa''' was a legendary [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] hero in the species' mythology, known for his strong will and regal bearing. "Chirpa" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="SW6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Shachu was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
